description: This file contains unit tests for custom grain activation in an Orleans-based distributed system. It verifies the ability to create grains without default dependency injection, handle disposal events, and configure custom activators for specific grain types. The tests include a custom grain activator implementation that bypasses DI and tracks grain disposal counts.
